_doc: Where the city scene (game/scenes/city.tscn) starts the player (P1-024). The game arg --spawn=<id> picks one, no arg takes `default`. A pin is a WGS84 point and a compass heading in degrees (0 north, 90 east); the game projects it with the world frame of the tile index, loads the ring there and stands the vehicle on the nearest lane at grade within 60 m whose direction is within 60 degrees of the heading, facing along that lane (game/world/world_stream.gd boot, lanes.gd snap). `vehicle` is the tune the player starts in. A pin whose tile is not in the loaded tile folder (the 9-tile test block has no Janpath) is skipped: the old start on the longest lane of the tile nearest India Gate applies. Points were read from the lane graph of the pilot bake (tools/fixtures/gen_city_routes.mjs starts its routes from the same pins).
